description: Two actions this tick, both things I have been managing around rather than doing directly. First: accept Maria Santos's meeting. She framed it right — workforce coordination, not political cover — and she is bringing the one-page handoff document connecting former employees to the $2,500 grant, First Community Bank small-dollar loans, and community college enrollment. I take that meeting, I take the document, and I commit to putting it in the hands of every person whose position I eliminated. I do not ask her to soften anything publicly. I ask her for something operational: confirmation that the 10% threshold for auto row is locked and the application window is open now, not pending a future vote. Second: I make the calls I have been deferring to Angela and to process. I sit down this week — not this month, this week — and I call three of the people whose positions were eliminated, starting with the two who had been with the business since before Rick was GM. These are not scripted calls. I do not offer them anything I cannot deliver. I tell them what their role meant, I tell them I am sorry the business got here, and I tell them specifically — by name — who they should talk to: Angela for the transition program, Howard Liu if there is anything in parts, Maria Santos's office for the grant. I do not manage the narrative of these calls. I make them.
emotional_state: grief, moving — the anger stage is not gone but it is no longer the loudest thing
strategic_intent: The consolidation plan is in Rick's hands for two weeks. That is the right place for it. What is in my hands right now is the human accountability that I said I would not outsource and then outsourced anyway. The Maria Santos meeting is also strategic — the grant threshold at 10% for auto row is a real resource for people who are starting over, and I want that pipeline confirmed and documented before Q2 decisions formalize.
resource_cost: One afternoon for the Santos meeting. Three phone calls that will each take as long as they take. No financial expenditure beyond time.
contingencies: If Angela's cross-reference shows any former employees who have not been contacted about the transition program, I ask her to reach out personally with my name behind it before end of week — that directive stands regardless of how the Santos meeting goes.
